messages:
Maya: Quick question for month close — we ran the Q1 prepay pricing experiment for Dedicated customers. We need guidance on how to defer the $120,000 in promotional credits applied to committed plans. Did Revenue Ops decide to accelerate revenue on activation or defer over committed term?

Liam: We flagged this as a promotion tied to usage thresholds — I thought deferral over the committed term. @Noah?

Noah: Accounting view: if credits are contingent on future usage, it's a contract modification / variable consideration. We should probably record as deferred revenue and amortize over the commit term unless there's a clear standalone performance obligation. Need GL mapping.

Ava: From Sales: the offer was 'first 3 months of committed capacity free up to 100k tokens' — customers received the credit at sign-up. We planned it as a ramp incentive, not immediate revenue.

Maya: OK — for month-end, can we post a deferral reversing entry to spread $120,000 over 12 months? Draft JE below:
```
Debit: 4005 - Sales Discounts (contra-rev) 120,000
Credit: 2102 - Deferred Revenue - Promotions 120,000
```

billing-bot: Reminder: invoices already show the credit as line-item 'Promo Credit'. No revenue was recorded on invoice. Ticket #B-4523.

Noah: JE looks fine but use account '4005 - Customer Credits' (instead of Sales Discounts) and '2102 - Deferred Revenue Promotions'. Also we need memo referencing the experiment id EX-2026-03-17. I'll approve after we add that.

Liam: Should we split by customer? One customer opted for a 24-month commit — need to prorate differently.

Maya: Good catch. We'll allocate by customer contract term. I'll export the list and run allocation. @Ava please confirm any outliers.

Ava: Will check contracts; flagging AcmeCorp has early-termination clause — if they churn before 12 months we need to recognize remaining deferred as revenue on termination? Probably accelerate per contract.

Noah: Add a contingent revenue reserve: if churn occurs, recognize remaining deferred as revenue upon termination per policy. For now leave as deferred.

Maya: Action items: 1) Maya export and allocate by contract (today EOD) 2) Noah finalize GL mappings & post JE 3) Liam update revenue schedule template with experiment id. I'll attach the export here when ready. :thumbsup:

Liam: :thumbsup: I'll add a column on schedule for experiment id.
